notes.content:

Hello, everyone! Welcome to our latest update, where we share the recent progress and improvements in the game.


What’s New
​We’ve made several under-the-hood upgrades to improve combat stability and performance.

To better support upcoming features around story engagement and rewards, story nodes now require energy to play.

The map now remembers your last played node and auto-focuses on it.

Tutorial has been simplified for a smoother start.

Energy potion UI has been improved for clarity.

UI scaling issues have been fixed.

Application stability improved when minimizing or switching windows.

Minor visual improvements to a cutscene.

New icons added to the character customizer.

Ongoing work on a new character shader for future flexibility.

We've boosted rewards across multiple daily and weekly missions, plus added energy potion drops to give you more ways to keep playing!



What We’re Working On
New 3-Star Mementos are in development!

More level environments​

A Rewards Calendar is coming: log in every day to earn something new!

We're also building a Reward Track system: complete missions, climb reward tiers, and collect big prizes!

New outfits for main characters are being designed.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45181394/4f43c662c831842c7536cbe16e7315425e6ee36e.png"]


Stay tuned for more updates coming soon!
